INSERT INTO batch_performance_log (job_name, execution_id, step_name, partition_id, status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, read_count, write_count, skip_count, records_per_second, cache_strategy, cache_key, data_source_ids, error_message, extra_info) VALUES
(#{log.jobName}, #{log.executionId}, #{log.stepName}, #{log.partitionId}, #{log.status}, #{log.startTime}, #{log.endTime}, #{log.durationMs}, #{log.readCount}, #{log.writeCount}, #{log.skipCount}, #{log.recordsPerSecond}, #{log.cacheStrategy}, #{log.cacheKey}, #{log.dataSourceIds}, #{log.errorMessage}, #{log.extraInfo})
mapper.select: SELECT job_name, execution_id, MIN(start_time) as start_time, MAX(end_time) as end_time, SUM(duration_ms) as duration_ms, SUM(read_count) as read_count, SUM(write_count) as write_count, SUM(skip_count) as skip_count, AVG(records_per_second) as records_per_second, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT status) as status FROM batch_performance_log WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} GROUP BY job_name, execution_id
